description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A shallow elongated woven cradle holds one blank removable ceramic spoon-rest insert. Side: The ceramic insert curves upward at one end above low bamboo feet. Rear: The rear rim shows a fitted lip securing the removable insert. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
